instruction_text:
calm, steady news narration with natural emphasis at key points and turns; not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: I try to pick up packages at a delivery office or a locker so I don't cause extra work with redelivery. It is handy to pick them up when it suits me, but I can't choose a locker for some things. Even when I ask for a package to go to a delivery office, it may arrive late, so sometimes I end up getting it in person after all. Still, I take the time to think about how to get my packages. Honestly, I think it's wrong that I pay the same fee as people who are always away and ask for redelivery. Redelivery takes up the delivery worker's time, so charging for it is fine. I'd be happy if the first redelivery were free, and people who were away again and again had to pay. But maybe that's just my view. The delivery office is nearby, and I can choose how to get my packages.
